environment.cold_definition: New renderer process per pair; startup excluded; disk cache not purged
environment.warm_definition: Same request(s), same renderer process; no client response cache
environment.processes: One renderer process at a time; one TiTiler Uvicorn worker; default internal CPU parallelism

previous_comparison.limitation: Historical end-to-end comparison, not an isolated Raster Style A/B or a statistical significance test.

same_session_control.limitation: Full current run followed by full preserved-binary control; shared current Range origin. Not randomized cross-version pairs or an isolated style-engine benchmark.
